summary: ICL Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a board-approved organizational restructuring effective January 1, 2027, aligning operations with its November 2025 strategy. The company will reorganize into four end-market divisions—Growing Solutions, Nutrition Solutions, Industrial Products, and Essential Minerals—replacing its current structure. Financial reporting will reflect four new segments from 2027. The filing includes unaudited historical segment data for Q1-Q2 2026 and FY2025 for investor reference. This is an internal reorganization and segment reporting change, not a special-situation transaction, but it may signal portfolio shifts.
